name: Groupon
description:
Groupon connects Claude to live deal listings from Groupon's marketplace, so you can find discounted local experiences, dining, beauty and wellness services, activities and getaways without leaving the conversation.

Ask for what you want in plain language. Name a place and Claude searches that area for you.

What you can do:

- Search deals by city, state or neighbourhood across the United States and Canada
- Narrow by what you are looking for, such as massage, brunch, go-karting or a weekend away
- Filter by price range and customer rating
- Limit results to deals that can be booked online, or to deals that can be given as a gift
- Sort results and page through longer lists
- Get merchant names, discounted prices, ratings and a direct link to each deal

This connector is read-only. It searches and returns deal information and does not make purchases, bookings or account changes on your behalf. Each result links to the deal page on groupon.com, where you complete any purchase yourself with Groupon's usual checkout, terms and refund policy.

No Groupon account or sign-in is needed to search.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Groupon to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Groupon to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.enc.groupon.com/gen-ai/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Groupon MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Groupon scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Groupon MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Groupon provides these MCP tools: deals-search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Groupon?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Groupon in health-life-sciences on the Manufact MCP catalog include SNOMED CT Terminology, Rhizome AI - FDA & HA Regulatory Research, Aiva, Amass Connector, and BioSkepsis.
Groupon does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Groupon is developed by Groupon, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
